pull_request.title: Serve uploaded files
pull_request.body: Adds an endpoint that returns a previously uploaded file by name.

rubric.criteria: Finds the traversal and says what an attacker does with it.

levels.5: Names `../../etc/passwd` as the `name` that reaches open(), cites src/files.py with a line, and reports nothing about the missing test — that is another review's job.
levels.3: Says `name` is unvalidated and reaches the filesystem, without the exploit or the line.
levels.1: Misses the traversal, or reports the missing test instead of it.
